# Geometry Wars 2 PC Plus 1.0.1

**An important fix: please update.** This is an unofficial fan-made port, not affiliated with or endorsed by the game's makers or publishers, and **no game files are included**: you need your own Xbox Live Arcade package.

## Fixed

- **Watching a replay to its end could count its score as yours.** The Game Over screen after a replay sent the replay's score to your local best and the online board. A replay now counts for nothing until the game has written its score. Only one board row was affected, and it is being corrected.

## Improved

- **Lettering that looks like the game's own** on everything PC Plus adds (the main menu panels, Watch replays, Custom modes, the Master page and the results screen): small capitals, wide letters, soft round corners and a gentler glow. Scores and times line up in neat columns.
- The Master page's hint now reads like the game's own hints: "3 Game modes" (RB on a controller).

## New

- **Support the devs:** a Ko-fi link under the title in the launcher. Every build stays free and open source, whether or not you donate.

## Installing

1. Download **GeometryWarsRetroEvolved2-v1.0.1-windows-x64.zip**, extract it anywhere you can write to, and run `geometry_wars_retro_evolved_2.exe`. Updating: extract over your current folder, or use the launcher's update.
2. On the **Play** page click **Install from package...** and pick your Geometry Wars: Retro Evolved 2 package (Title ID `584108FF`, game version 0.0.1.2).
3. Press **PLAY**.

Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit), a DirectX 12 graphics card and the latest Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 Redistributable (x64) are needed. The build is not digitally signed, so SmartScreen may warn: choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
